lead: Gemini 4 Argon dominated Wednesday: [Google began rolling it out to trusted cyber defenders](../summaries/cbdadf4d036f.md), [Artificial Analysis says it matches GPT-6 Astra at lower cost](../summaries/27fd4f2ee0fc.md), and [employees told Bloomberg it lags on real coding](../summaries/041745345ef4.md). Elsewhere, [Anthropic's IPO prospectus drew skeptical commentary](../summaries/baa6806bccdb.md) and [Micron posted $54B quarterly revenue](../summaries/574749f79a67.md).
